title: eludite.resx.sets input
description: List the resource sets of the workspace or one project (proposal 0005): every neutral `.resx` with its culture files, counts of strings, missing cells and warnings, the designer file and the access modifier. With a host (a .NET workspace) the sets are the projects' `EmbeddedResource` items (`eludite/resx/sets`); without one, or for files no project lists, they are found by walking the workspace for `*.resx` under the search excludes. Nothing is parsed at startup: the first call parses the files, off the UI thread, and the sets stay cached until a file changes.

project.description: Only this project's sets (its name as the Workspace window shows it, or its project file's path). Default: the whole workspace.

path.description: Only the sets under this folder, or the set this file belongs to (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder).

include_non_string.description: Also list sets whose neutral file has no string entry (a WinForms form's `Form1.resx`). Default: false.
